verdict.rationale: Evidence shows narrow instances of AI-generated insight/suggestion from user data — buyers get 'personalized recommendations' during chat commerce, and the Link CLI wallet lets an agent 'retrieve permissioned financial data to answer questions about spending, balances, and trends' (e.g., 'What did I spend on dining this month?'). This is real but thin — it's a side feature of a payments/commerce infra product, not a dedicated insights/analytics capability with elaboration or hands-on validation. Missing for 10: dedicated in-product analytics/insights surface beyond brief doc mentions, detail on recommendation quality/methodology, and independent corroboration that these insight features work as described.
